title: We Are Pausing the Teleport Bug Bounty Program
summary: An update on the Teleport bug bounty program.
body_markdown:
Teleport is pausing our bug bounty program.


Bug bounties have long been a staple of a good product security program. Teleport has enjoyed working with a long list of researchers via our bug bounty program, and has paid more than $200,000 in bounties since starting the program in 2022.


In the past two years, the nature of product security has changed. With increased capabilities from AI security tools, we've observed a decrease in bug bounty submission quality. Almost all submissions we receive now are duplicates of internal findings discovered using AI which have already been triaged, often as false positives.


Teleport's Security and Engineering teams find more value looking for critical and high vulnerabilities in our product security posture through our internal efforts and via the engagement of the best specialized teams in the world.


We are re-allocating the money we spend on the bug bounty platform, and the bounty pool toward engaging more frequently with our preferred penetration test and red team providers Calif, Doyensec, and Persistent Security.


To learn more about our internal efforts to find bugs with LLMs, see this post:[https://goteleport.com/blog/finding-vulnerabilities-with-llms/](https://goteleport.com/blog/finding-vulnerabilities-with-llms/)
